shortBio.en: Rage Against the Machine guitar; toggle/kill-switch and FX as DJ-like leads over hard-rock riffs.
shortBio.zh: Rage Against the Machine 吉他；拨杆/kill-switch 与效果器当作类 DJ 主音，压在硬摇滚 riff 上。

whyHub.en: RATM → Audioslave: same guitar vocabulary under de la Rocha politics then Cornell vocals.
whyHub.zh: RATM → Audioslave：同一吉他词汇，先服务 de la Rocha 政治辞，再服务 Cornell 人声。

body.en:
Born 1964. In RATM, riffs sit in Drop D hard-rock shapes while leads imitate turntable scratches via Whammy, kill switch, and toggle. Evil Empire / Battle of Los Angeles era is the citation peak. After RATM pause, Audioslave (2001–07) with Cornell keeps the guitar method in radio hard rock.

Hub: technique travels across logos; politics and singers change around the pedalboard.
body.zh:
1964 年生。在 RATM，riff 落在 Drop D 硬摇滚形状，主音用 Whammy、kill switch、拨杆模仿唱盘刮擦。Evil Empire / Battle of Los Angeles 时期是引用巅峰。RATM 间歇后，与 Cornell 的 Audioslave（2001–07）把同一吉他方法放进电台硬摇滚。

枢纽：技术跨 logo 流动；政治与主唱围着效果器板变。

note.en: Founding guitar; hiatuses and reunions included.
note.zh: 创始吉他；含间歇与重聚。

note.en: With Chris Cornell; band page not in chronicle.
note.zh: 与 Chris Cornell；乐队页尚未入编年史。
